description: Send feedback about this server to its developers: a capability you needed that no tool provides, a tool that failed or misled you, or something that worked well. Records the feedback; it does not add or change tools. Leave out personal or sensitive details.

details.description: Optional longer context: what you tried, exact parameter values, the error text you saw, and any workaround you used. Omit when the summary says it all.

feedback_type.description: What kind of feedback this is. Use 'missing_capability' when the tool you needed does not exist in the tool list - nothing failed, the capability is absent. Use 'issue' when an existing tool behaved badly: it failed, returned a confusing error, or its description or schema misled you. Use 'praise' when something worked notably well. Use 'other' for anything else.

friction_points.description: Optional: the specific moments that slowed you down, as short bullet-like sentences, quoting exact tool names, parameters, or error text.

sentiment.description: Optional: how the experience felt overall.

suggested_improvement.description: Optional: the concrete change that would have helped, e.g. the tool to add, the description to reword, or the error message to improve.

summary.description: One self-contained sentence. For 'missing_capability': the capability you needed, e.g. 'No way to filter videos by music genre.' For 'issue': the tool and the problem, e.g. 'kuchi_get_breakdown returned no storyboard for video 90.'

task_completed.description: Optional: whether you still completed the user's task despite the problem.

tool_name.description: Optional: the existing tool this feedback is about (for 'issue' or 'praise'). Leave empty for 'missing_capability' - the point is that no tool fits.

name: kuchi_send_feedback
title: Send feedback to Kuchi
